subject: Quickproof: hosted API 20-min eval + API key steps
messages:
From: Kai Zhou <kai@searchly.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API quick eval (self-serve signup finished)

Hi Mina / Diego,

I signed up and walked through the self-serve quickstart today — nice docs. We have a short timeline to validate latency/cost for a small search-augmentation PoC and would love a 20-minute run-through of the Hosted API (generation + embeddings) and the sandbox.

A few quick details from our side:
- Org: Searchly (searchly.io)
- Primary contact: me (Kai) — PST timezone
- Use case: embedding-based retrieval + light generative prompts (max 512 tokens)

Can we do a 20-minute session this week? Prefer mornings 9–11am PT. Also quick question: do you provision scoped API keys or should we use the trial token from signup?

Thanks — Kai
Kai Zhou
Lead ML Engineer, Searchly
kai@searchly.io

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Zhou <kai@searchly.io>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API quick eval (self-serve signup finished)

Hi Kai — great to meet you (virtually) and welcome!

We can absolutely run a focused 20-minute session and validate latency + tokens with your sample prompts. Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed Oct 7 — 10:00–10:20am
- Wed Oct 7 — 11:30–11:50am
- Thu Oct 8 — 9:30–9:50am

Ben (copied) is our Solutions Engineer and will join to walk through sandbox provisioning and a quick rate-limit / batching note.

About API access: we can either have you continue with the trial token (fine for quick tests) or we can create a short-lived scoped API key / service account that only has read-only embedding+generate access for the sandbox project. If you'd like the scoped key, please reply with the domain you want associated (e.g. searchly.io) and a preferred TTL (default 8 hours) and we will provision it before the call.

Attached is a short pre-demo checklist — quick items to speed the session up (browser, sample prompt list, 1–2 example documents for embeddings).

If none of the times work, tell us a window and we'll adapt.

Best,
Mina Haddad
SDR, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Attachment: short-technical-checklist.pdf (1 page)

From: Kai Zhou <kai@searchly.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API quick eval (self-serve signup finished)

Thanks, Mina — appreciate the quick options. Wed Oct 7 10:00am PT works for us.

Domain to associate for a scoped key: searchly.io
TTL: 6 hours is perfect — we'll run a few runs.

Avery Retail (our PM) will drop in for the first 10 minutes; cc'ing her separately if helpful. We'll paste a couple of short prompt examples below so Ben can see expected load/shape.

Sample prompts:
1) "Return top-3 product ids for query: 'waterproof hiking boots size 10'" (embedding similarity + exact match)
2) "Generate short product blurb from attributes: color, waterproof true, materials" (approx 120 tokens)

See you Wed 10:00 PT.

— Kai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Zhou <kai@searchly.io>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Hosted API quickproof — invite + service-account steps

Hi Kai / team — adding some logistics ahead of the 10:00 PT call.

1) Calendar: I've sent the 20-minute calendar invite for Wed Oct 7 10:00–10:20am PT. Please accept if the slot looks good.

2) Scoped API key (service account) — summary steps:
   - We created a sandbox project "searchly-quickproof" and will bind a service account to it.
   - To provision the scoped key I need: (a) domain (searchly.io — got it), (b) contact email for key delivery (kai@searchly.io), (c) list of endpoints to enable (embedding, generate).
   - I will provision a key with 6-hour TTL and send it as a one-time secret link 1 hour before the call.

3) Quick curl example you can test immediately (trial token):
   curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
     -H "Authorization: Bearer $TRIAL_TOKEN" 
     -d '{"model":"rwd-embedding-lite","input":["sample text"]}'

4) On-call focus: latency profiling (p99), batch size tradeoffs, and a quick token-cost estimate for a small nightly batch job.

Attachment: service-account-instructions.md (text)

If anything changes, ping me in-thread and I can adjust. Looking forward to it.

— Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API quick eval — confirmation

Kai — calendar accepted, invite confirmed. I'll hand the session off to Ben at 10:00 PT.

Ben will post the one-time secret link for the scoped key 1 hour before the session; if you'd prefer the trial token now for preflight tests, reply and I'll paste a short snippet.

Thanks and see you shortly.
